newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 206,500 running bales (RB) exceeded the previous week by two-thirds and were two and two-fifths times the 4-week average.

The major increases were for China (94,900 RB), Mexico (44,100 RB), Turkey (14,800 RB), and Thailand (7,700 RB). Sales of 38,100 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Canada (24,200 RB).
Exports of 197,100 RB--a marketing-year high--were 21 percent above the previous week and 9 percent above the 4-week average.
Asian destinations accounted for 60 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 35 percent; West European, 4 percent; and African, 1 percent.
